title: Sorry
label: ch:fr-sorry
canDo: I can apologise in French and pick between je suis désolé(e), pardon and excusez-moi for the situation I am actually in.

payoff.summary: Say je suis désolé(e) knowing it literally means 'I am desolate', then place pardon as the quick reflex and excusez-moi as the attention-getter. The chapter's only lesson, so the payoff covers everything it introduces.
